data.text:
IN PHOTOS | Workers conduct repair works inside the sunog apog pumping station in Tondo, Manila on Sunday (August 17). 

Manila Mayor Isko Moreno blamed defective pumping stations for the flooding experienced in his city during the onslaught of the southwest monsoon. 

Senator Marcoleta called on the public to help the Senate investigate by filing complaints against those responsible for substandard or anomalous projects in their jurisdictions. 

📷 Norman Cruz

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.

#TrafficUpdate

 We're having good vehicular movement from Oshodi express way inward Apakun, NAHCO and International Airport road, both inward and outward of main carriage way are good for now.
While movement inward Ajao estate, Fatai irawo junction, Awoniyi Elemo junction, Lateef salami Street connecting Asa afariogun Street inward Eleganza roundabout looks good as well, but approaching Chivita, Canoe towards NNPC junction is a  slow movement due to high influx at the moment.

Aye junction inward Osolo way by Aswani market down to Aswani roundabout towards 7and8 junction is also good at the moment.
